answer_1.quote: ... we pose multi-hop reasoning as a sequence-to-sequence problem, we use a Transformer encoder-decoder model to "translate" a query sequence to a path sequence ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated reasoning paths as sequences of entity and relation tokens

answer_2.quote: We compute the metrics, including Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Hits at N (H@N) under filtered setting.

answer_4.quote: We manually annotate the interpretability score for paths generated by our model and baseline models. For each triple query, we select the top generated reasoning path ... and score it based on whether it is convincing to a human.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each generated path as 1 (reasonable), 0.5 (partially reasonable), or 0 (unreasonable) based on its ability to deduce the relationship.
